landing.heroHeadline: Know which businesses need a website, and why.
landing.heroSubtitle: Leads4dev collects business data across Egypt, cleans it, scores it with fixed rules, then matches it to your specialty and city.
landing.problemStripSubtitle: Three recurring problems that waste developers and agencies time in Egypt
landing.problemCol1Text: The same business appears under different names and scattered numbers.
landing.problemCol1Solution: We perform entity resolution to merge duplicate records before listing.
landing.problemCol2Text: Outdated contact lists containing dead or wrong numbers.
landing.problemCol2Solution: Continuous verification and precise chronological tracking on every record.
landing.problemCol3Title: Businesses that already have modern websites
landing.problemCol3Text: Leads of businesses that already run modern sites and have no redevelopment need.
landing.problemCol3Solution: Technical domain, SSL, and mobile responsiveness checks to confirm actual need.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Three clear stages from data deduplication to deal tracking
landing.howStep1Title: We clean data and prevent duplicates.
landing.howStep1Desc: We aggregate business records from multiple sources and merge duplicate entries for the same entity before listing.
landing.howStep2Title: We score on two axes: Opportunity and Quality.
landing.howStep2Desc: We separate how strongly a business needs a website (Opportunity Score) from how fresh and verified its contact data is (Quality Score).
landing.howStep3Title: You unlock contact data and track the deal.
landing.howStep3Desc: Inspect the full score breakdown for free, then spend points to unlock contact details and manage your sales pipeline.
landing.howStep1MergedNote: Phone identity match automatically detected and merged into a single canonical record.
landing.howStep2FrameNote: Every score is backed by inspectable rule contributions that you can verify before purchasing.
landing.howStep3Footnote: Every unlocked lead enters your deal pipeline to log outreach notes and contract progress.

landing.ownershipSubtitle: Total transparency in seats, balance, and acquisition cost
landing.ownershipExclusiveDesc: Sold to one developer only and closed immediately from the marketplace.
landing.ownershipSharedDesc: Available to a limited pool of developers (max 3) at lower credit cost.
landing.ownershipBalanceNotice: Instant deduction from credits ledger with no hidden fees.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Choose the right plan for your business with easy upgrades anytime
landing.commitmentsSubtitle: Strict operational principles we uphold to protect your time and investment
landing.weDo1: Scoring and matching decisions strictly follow inspectable engineering rules.
landing.weDo2: Wrong number reports trigger immediate re-verification rather than silent deletion.
landing.weDo3: Complete audit logs for every credit transaction ensuring total financial transparency.
landing.weDo4: Stale leads and records failing quality gates are immediately blocked from sale.
landing.weDont1: We never rely on random guesswork to compute prices or scores.
landing.weDont2: We never sell unverified or expired business leads.
landing.weDont3: We never resell an exclusive lead to any other party under any circumstance.
landing.weDont4: We never lock you into long-term contracts or unannounced hidden fees.
landing.faqSubtitle: Clear and direct answers about Leads4dev and how to make the most of it
landing.faqQ1: What is a sales lead in Leads4dev?
landing.faqA1: A lead is a verified business in Egypt confirmed to need website development or redesign, with verified contact info and digital presence.
landing.faqQ2: What is the difference between exclusive and shared leads?
landing.faqA2: An exclusive lead is sold to one developer and closed immediately. A shared lead is offered to up to 3 developers at a lower credit cost.
landing.faqA3: Each subscription plan grants monthly credits. One credit unlocks full verified contact details for one qualified sales opportunity.
landing.faqQ4: What happens if a phone number is wrong?
landing.faqA4: Report it from your pipeline dashboard. The system freezes the lead, verifies it, and refunds your credit if confirmed invalid.
landing.faqQ5: How are lead data and quality verified?
landing.faqA5: Every lead undergoes automated domain, server, phone validity, and freshness checks with deterministic quality rules.
landing.faqA6: Freelance web developers, agencies, and software houses in Egypt offering website design and digital solutions.
landing.faqA7: Create an account in one minute, complete onboarding with your target cities and skills, and access matched leads right away.
landing.finalCtaTitle: Access qualified Egyptian business leads today
landing.finalCtaSubtitle: Join web developers across Egypt leveraging deterministic, verified opportunities.
